registries.title: Registries
registries.caption: Credentials Bayplan uses to pull images and browse tags. Pulls pick the most specific match automatically.

table.title: Registries
table.errorBody: The server may be busy. Try again.

search.label: Search credentials
search.placeholder: Search by name, registry or username

manage.title: No registry credentials
manage.body: Add one so private images pull on every node without a docker login. Public images work without one.

view.title: No registry credentials apply here
view.body: Public images pull without one. Ask an administrator to add a credential if you need a private registry.

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.body: Pulls this credential would have matched fall back to the next matching credential, or to anonymous. Nothing else refers to it.
delete.permission: You no longer have permission to do that. Your access may have changed.
delete.generic: Couldn't delete the credential. Try again.

add.title: Add a registry credential
add.description: Stored encrypted. The secret can't be shown again after you save.

loadError.title: Couldn't load this credential.
loadError.body: Check the connection and try again.
loadError.notFound: This credential doesn't exist, or you can't see it.

helper.dockerhub: Use a Docker Hub access token, not your password. Create one under Account settings → Personal access tokens.
helper.ghcr: Use a personal access token (classic) with the read:packages scope.
helper.gitlab: Use a deploy token with read_registry, or a personal access token with read_registry.
helper.generic: Use a static token or password. Amazon ECR tokens expire after 12 hours, so they need replacing often.

name.label: Name
name.helper: Shown in the table, in pull progress and in error messages.

scope.label: Scope
scope.helper: Instance credentials apply to every environment. Pick an environment to limit it to one.
scope.fixed: A credential's scope can't change. Create a new one instead.

host.label: Registry
host.helper: To browse a registry mirror, add it here as a generic registry. Bayplan never uses the mirrors set on your nodes.
host.readOnly: This host is read-only (set on the host)

prefix.label: Namespace (optional)
prefix.helper: Only images under this path use this credential. Leave empty to cover the whole registry.

secret.label: Secret
secret.keepLast4: Leave empty to keep the one ending {{last4}}
secret.keepStored: Leave empty to keep the stored secret

hubFallback.label: Use for all Docker Hub pulls
hubFallback.helper: Raises the anonymous pull limit for every Docker Hub image that has no more specific credential. One per scope.

expires.label: Expires (optional)
expires.helper: Bayplan warns 7 days before. It doesn't renew anything.

view.description: You can see this credential but not change it.
view.label: Credential details
view.name: Name
view.hubFallbackYes: Used when no more specific credential matches

errors.name_invalid: Use 1 to 64 letters, digits, spaces and . _ ( ) -.
errors.host_invalid: Use a host like ghcr.io or registry.example.com:5000.
errors.prefix_invalid: Use a path like acme or acme/team.
errors.hub_prefix_required: Docker Hub needs a namespace like acme, or tick “Use for all Docker Hub pulls”.
errors.hub_fallback_not_hub: Only a Docker Hub credential can be used for all Docker Hub pulls.
errors.expiry_invalid: Pick a date in the future.
errors.expiry_past: Pick a date in the future.
errors.nameTaken: A credential named {{name}} already exists in {{scope}}.
errors.hostPrefixTaken: {{scope}} already has a credential for {{target}}. Edit that one instead.
errors.hubFallbackTaken: “{{name}}” already uses all Docker Hub pulls for {{scope}}. Untick it there first.
errors.hubFallbackTakenUnnamed: Another credential already uses all Docker Hub pulls for {{scope}}. Untick it there first.
errors.permission: You no longer have permission to do that. Your access may have changed.
errors.generic: Couldn't save the credential. Try again.
